dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.ui.statusline.color-refactoring>
<!description: Use parent's foreground color instead of system widget foreground for status line labels. This helps in cases where the parent's color might be customized, promoting UI consistency.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: eclipse-ui, color, refactoring, swt>

$label.getDisplay().getSystemColor(org.eclipse.swt.SWT.COLOR_WIDGET_FOREGROUND) :: instanceof($label, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Label")
=>
$label.getParent().getForeground()
;;
